label: Finding-17
title: huntress-none: 'No public exploit code known' is dated before release, not 20:30 UTC on 21 October
description: The sentence 'we're not aware of public exploit code as of this writing' sits in the original pre-release section ('The fixes aren't out yet'), i.e. about 20 October. The claim and impact.json put it under 'as of 20:30 UTC on 21 October'. By then Amazon reports PoCs 'within hours' of release, CCCS says a PoC is available, and watchTowr reports PoC code on GitHub. Split the two halves and date each.
